ICS 13.040.20CHD 35Revised Standard from Last Update.1. SCOPE1.1 This standard (Part 7) prescribes a method for the measurement of concentration of hydrogen sulphide (H2S) in ambient air.1.2 The range of concentration covered in this method is 6 to 600 µg/m3 of H2S in air.2. REFERENCESThe standards listed below contain provisions which, through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid.
